brief.zh: 完成 charge_twice(current, first, second)。导入 charge_total，把第一轮的结果用作第二轮的起点，再返回最终电量。
brief.en: Complete charge_twice(current, first, second). Import charge_total, use the result of the first round as the starting charge of the second, and return the final charge.

concept.zh: 在新函数中重复调用导入的函数
concept.en: Call an imported helper twice inside a new function

hints.zh: 第一次调用用参数 current 和 first。把返回值交给 after_first。
hints.en: Call the helper with current and first, and store the result in after_first.

hints.zh: 第二次把 after_first 和 second 交给同一个函数。
hints.en: Give after_first and second to the same helper on the second call.

label.en: Add the second round and return
